signal.purpose: Single trigger: asks every question once, then runs the PM pipeline and the Engineering Director on their recommended defaults, stopping at the PRD freeze and the PR plan
signal.use_when: The user types /signal with a request and wants it taken from idea to a ready PR plan in one run

pm.purpose: PM Director — routes every request to the minimum set of agents, owns .pm/state.md, runs the four checkpoints
pm.use_when: Always the entry point. The user talks to the Director, never to agents directly.

setup.purpose: Bootstraps a product: creates .pm/state.md, then records the product, users, market and north star as Facts and domain terms as Glossary entries
setup.use_when: No .pm/state.md exists yet for this product

maintain-context.purpose: Archives the oldest Facts when they pass the limit, and writes a session handoff so the next session resumes cleanly
maintain-context.use_when: state.js check reports over the fact limit, or the session is ending

discovery.purpose: Frame stage: inventory, research, then six brainstorm lenses, ending in the concepts brief
discovery.use_when: A new idea has no concepts brief yet, or the brief has no evidence behind it

prioritize.purpose: Buckets discovery tasks into v0/v1/v2 with an explicit cut line and reasoning
prioritize.use_when: A task list exists and needs a scope decision

prd.purpose: Drafts the PRD section by section from the concepts brief, then writes acceptance criteria; freezes it once review passes
prd.use_when: Scope is locked and the work needs a spec

gtm-check.purpose: Ship gate — returns SHIP or DO NOT SHIP with the specific unmet condition
gtm-check.use_when: A PRD is frozen and the work is close to launch

ux-review.purpose: Critiques UI across conversion, accessibility, heuristics, and brand from source code or screenshots
ux-review.use_when: There is a UI to critique — frontend source in the repo, or screenshots provided

research.purpose: Facts from outside the building through one of four lenses, using web search
research.use_when: The question cannot be answered from state, the repo, or the user

ac-agent.purpose: Writes testable acceptance criteria for the engineering handoff
ac-agent.use_when: A PRD is approved and needs criteria a developer can test against

red-team.purpose: Attacks the design — money-loss paths, fraud vectors, race conditions, partial-failure states, reconciliation holes, regulatory exposure
red-team.use_when: A design or PRD touches money, identity, state transitions, or an external provider

data-model.purpose: Turns a PRD into entities, state machines, invariants, and migration/backfill notes
data-model.use_when: The feature introduces new entities or new states on existing ones

design-flow.purpose: Builds a mock-data prototype from a frozen PRD by copying real production pages and adding only the change, with screenshots and a differences-vs-production list
design-flow.use_when: A frozen PRD adds or changes screens

tickets.purpose: Turns a frozen PRD version into one PRD-style backlog ticket
tickets.use_when: A PRD version is frozen and the work needs a ticket in a tracker

metrics.purpose: Defines success, the events that must fire, and the query that answers whether it worked
metrics.use_when: A PRD exists without a measurement plan

ground.purpose: Checks claims about the existing system against the deployed code, searching every repo and area, and records evidence with the ref and commit
ground.use_when: A PRD or discovery makes a claim about what the existing system does or lacks

inventory.purpose: Scans existing docs, tickets, memory and wiki on a topic and classifies how each relates, before anything new is written
inventory.use_when: Before discovery or tickets, when .pm/existing.md is missing or stale

review-zoom-out.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review of simplicity and scope: over-engineering, YAGNI, reinvention, wrong altitude
review-zoom-out.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-comprehension.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review as a newcomer: undefined terms, assumed steps, vague claims
review-comprehension.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-design.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review of architecture, scale, failure modes, security and unproven assumptions
review-design.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-structural.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review of required sections, heading order, formatting and links
review-structural.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-style.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review of writing: plain words, no fluff, no opinion, final state only
review-style.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-readiness.purpose: Fresh-context read-only review of whether an engineer can build from the document with no further design choices
review-readiness.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document

review-codebase.purpose: Fresh-context read-only check of the document against .pm/evidence.md and read-only git: false statements, missing references, missed reuse
review-codebase.use_when: A review stage is running on a PRD, spec or design document, and .pm/evidence.md exists

review-synthesizer.purpose: Runs the reviewers of one stage in parallel, dedupes, triages Blocker, Major and Nit, writes the stage report and returns only its path; stage brainstorm runs the six idea lenses and writes the concepts brief
review-synthesizer.use_when: A review stage must run on a document, or the frame stage needs its brainstorm lenses

resolve.purpose: Sorts review findings into CONTEST, ESCALATE, PROPOSE FIX or DECLINE and walks the user through them one question at a time, in the main thread
resolve.use_when: A review stage report exists in .pm/review/ and the document needs its findings settled

eng.purpose: Engineering Director: plans tasks from a frozen PRD, runs build, review, fix, QA and the release gate with separate agents, local commits only
eng.use_when: A PRD is frozen and its acceptance criteria are ready to build

builder.purpose: Implements exactly one task in its own worktree, tests first when the repo has tests, and commits locally without pushing
builder.use_when: The Engineering Director has an approved task ready to build, or findings to fix

task-reviewer.purpose: Read-only review of one task's diff against the task, its criteria and the latest main; Blocker, Major, Nit with file and line
task-reviewer.use_when: A task is built and needs a fresh-context review

backend-review.purpose: Read-only judgement review of a backend diff against the backend checklist items the backend-check script cannot test; Blocker, Major, Nit with checklist item and file and line
backend-review.use_when: The release gate for acme_backend has passed backend-check and needs the judgement items reviewed

qa.purpose: Runs the repo tests and exercises each acceptance criterion of one reviewed task, reporting pass or fail with commands and output; never edits code
qa.use_when: A task has passed review and needs testing against its acceptance criteria

pr-split.purpose: Groups planned tasks into ordered PRs of at most 20 files and 600 changed lines, each a complete step that builds and passes its tests alone
pr-split.use_when: The Engineering Director has a task list and needs it grouped into reviewable PRs
